notes.title: v1.1.5 New Feature Customer Demands
notes.content:
Hello!
In this update, we've added the Customer Demands  mechanic to the game! Now, you'll need to perform washes based on your customers' specific needs.

As a new detail, detergents and softeners must be loaded into the machines according to their content type. When you hover over these products, you'll see which content type they belong to.

Washing clothes according to your customers' requests will earn you extra money, while ignoring them will reduce your profit.
We hope this new mechanic enhances your gameplay experience!

Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue with customers waiting outside
- Increased earnings from washes
- Adjusted profits for Washer&Dryer machines

notes.title: v1.1.4 Bug Fix

- General fix for broken NPC states and baskets
- Task progress fixed for machine tasks
- Tutorial window empty view fixed
- Detergent and fabric softener slot visual fixed
- Broken machine state and parts on load fixed
